decisions.statement: The page type the folders hold is handed in rather than written here.
The words a refusal is said in are handed in with that page type.
Each page has a folder to itself.
A folder with any file of its own is refused.
Every page in the folder is a part the page above declares.
A folder above holding no page is asked for no part.
Whether the page above is asked for that part at all is handed in.
Nothing here reads the name of the folder it judges.

definition: how a folder of page folders of one type is judged
